ab:
An attack that deals damage to critters and small dinosaurs only.
Deals additional damage to critters.

Allows climbing by using Jump while facing climbable terrain.
While climbing, press Jump again to fall or hold and release Jump to leap off.
Being idle while climbing does not drain stamina.

Copy any vocal call you heard with the 'Capture' emote in the last 30 seconds from dinosaurs within 400 meters, and play it back all using your Emote wheel.
Store up to 16 calls. A new capture replaces the oldest. They can be removed through the Emote wheel 'Customize' menu.
By default, they are kept on logout and lost on death.
Can eat fresh meat, carrion and insects.

Survive one fatal attack if you have more than 25% health. It will restore some health and stamina and grants 10 seconds of immunity to all damage.
While immune, you cannot deal any damage.
Can only activate once every 5 minutes.

Activate to capture any eligible active vocal call abilities in 50 meters from any dinosaur which have been used in the last 120 seconds.
You can capture up to 2 calls, swapping out the oldest with any newly captured calls.

Latch onto another creature, allowing you to perform attacks and other abilities. Release from the latch by jumping. Will automatically release when out of stamina. Deal 50% less damage while latched.

Latch onto a target to gain a decaying armor buff of 200% for 5 seconds.
Leap high into the air when detaching from pounced enemies.
Cannot be knocked off while latched.
Reduces stamina drain and altitude loss while gliding.

Increases the health regeneration of the dinosaur you are latched onto by 50%.
Does not stack.

Use while pounced to provide a small healing-over-time buff, or while grounded to dance and heal dinosaurs within 30 meters. When grouped, only group members are affected; otherwise, all dinosaurs are affected.
If not grouped, every dinosaur will be buffed.
Does not stack.
Does not heal during combat.
Does not heal through bleed.
Able to jump again mid-air. Only usable for the first 2 seconds after leaving the ground.

When gliding, stamina drains 2 times slower. If gliding within 50 meters of any other flying player, stamina drains 4 times slower instead.
Does not stack.

Increases jump height.
Take 10% reduced fall damage.
Reduces jump stamina cost by 15%.

Increases Bite damage to critters by 100%.
Heal yourself by 15% when using Bite while pounced on an enemy.

Increased health recovery by 25% while equipped.
Buff all Raptors in group when 2 or more Deinonychus with Pack Hunter are within 75 meters:
2 Pack Hunters: 20% increased damage.
3 Pack Hunters: 25% decreased pounce stamina drain.

While pounced on a player, automatically leech up to 60% of their venom, toxin, poison, bleed or paralysis.
Does not stack.

Increases acceleration of the dinosaur you are latched onto by 25%.
Stacks up to 4 times.
Increases your status effect healing by 50% while 'Shared Burden' is active.

Increases the movement speed of the dinosaur you are latched onto by 15%.
Buff is reduced to only 5% in combat.
Does not stack.
Movement Speed Bonus Out Of Combat

Activate for a quick forward boost of speed.
Not usable while in water.
